description: This file provides helper methods for creating comments within integration tests for the Comments feature in an ASP.NET Core project. It includes a method to create a comment, handle user creation if necessary, and fetch the comment from the database to verify its creation.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Creates a comment on an article for a specified user (or a default user if none is specified), executes the comment creation handler, and retrieves the created comment from the database, performing necessary checks.
